# discord_color (Data Source)

Converts a hex color code to a decimal integer for use in Discord role colors.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hex` (String) The hex color code (e.g., `#5b2c8e` or `5b2c8e`).

### Read-Only

- `dec` (Number) The decimal representation of the color.
